name: 3D Puffy Icon
description: Turn any SVG icon into a soft, inflated 3D tile that leans toward the cursor. One WebGL renderer draws every icon on the page, and each one renders only when it moves.

props.name: svg
props.description: An SVG string with filled paths. Stroke-only icons have nothing to extrude, so use a filled icon set.

props.name: roundness
props.description: The tile's outline, from 0 = square to 1 = circle.

props.name: puff
props.description: Tile thickness as a share of its width.

props.name: iconScale
props.description: Icon width as a share of the tile.

props.name: iconDepth
props.description: How far the icon stands out of the tile.

props.name: tilt
props.description: How far the tile leans toward the pointer, in degrees. 0 keeps it still.

props.name: rest
props.description: The resting angle in degrees, [x, y].

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the square wrapper. It fills its parent's width, so size it with w-* or max-w-*.
